main.description: Create an account for an automated agent acting for the caller (its principal, https://ident.link), in one step: the account, whose genesis PLC operation lists https://ident.link/agent-of/<caller DID> in alsoKnownAs, and the caller's link.ident.endorsement of it, in the caller's repo. Only accounts the PDS allows (COCOON_AGENT_PRINCIPALS) may call it, and agent accounts may not. OAuth callers need rpc:at.hailey.cocoon.createAgent?aud=<the PDS's DID> and repo:link.ident.endorsement. Agent accounts can't change their own identity.

handle.description: Under the PDS's domain; omitted, one is picked.

recoveryKey.description: A did:key the principal holds offline, first in the agent's rotation keys.

password.description: Signs in as the agent. Returned once.

endorsed.description: False when the endorsement couldn't be written after the account was made: write it with com.atproto.repo.putRecord.
